# PASS: narrow partial-retry source, plan and bootstrap review

Reviewed commit: `7a6ed056e5e8e1ee2d220b6b7b7749fefa5eefe1`, relative to
`15764cf0a1e72ea97876d174863ac217b2ba7aa7`. Both writers were released.
All 18 changed paths match the committed bytes and lead inventory. No blocking
findings remain at this source/zero-call preparation boundary.

## Exact accepted bindings

- Canonical plan: `738c380aa2e3fcdb5910dfcecb0ee8f87a1acf065b8d396c22f0677d40084794`.
- Plan file: `2e3f90f5e9dd4348175ce6cbc689e10dfc434b6c35f0adc906f3f385d7445193`.
- Wrapper: `14f12e72f49fc03608c3d5689085da7242e004b6b8586b5ee7371eb53bedfdfe`.
- Bootstrap: `6c458f8acb2ff8842a401ec3f3ab593d1819df9559e2dfa38e2d8aade90723bd`.
- Offline artifact manifest: `158addc8a3ea5f4fb3f2bce568ac4554eefd7eb889202e0c0e2628f6950852a6`.

## Independent verification

- Normal scoped pytest passed: **67 tests in 10.55 seconds**, without a custom
  basetemp. The permitted test-owned temporary namespace exception applies.
- The native fake integration completes a fresh whole case with 32 SDK fixture
  requests, including native repairs, and all 18 mounted comparisons. An empty
  valid RED list yields 12 comparisons after 23 fixture requests and remains
  partial, with a persisted coverage stop and no completed-detection credit.
  Provider HTTP 500 stops after one fixture request; unresolved semantic output
  stops after two. Resume adds no requests to the completed case.
- Existing RequestJournal directly enforces 80 cumulative attempts and the
  plan binding; no new generic retry mechanism or old stop reset was introduced.
- The native fake aggregate preserves the other 39 rows, qualifies three
  intervals, counts 1,278 historical plus 32 fixture requests, preserves unknown
  whole token totals, and rejects stale saved accounting before overwriting an
  aggregate.
- Independently validated the exact prepared plan against frozen source37,
  profile digest `0ca72c2f933e0f03adc15b70bc362be269865222c41cdb0a42208b9185f47403`,
  the single unchanged packet SHA
  `5659b7390f3c71ace07ec6cc29d3b2b913c7f3912c9d7b5145895ecddeaeec37`,
  runtime/helper/bootstrap hashes and copied accepted adjudication.
- Real reviewer identity is rejected before application loading. Fake release
  declarations reject false authorization and changed plan/budget/retry fields.
  An instrumented execution of the exact bootstrap confirms authentication,
  isolated credential-disabled preflight, then the cold dotenv/run boundaries.
  Those credential and dispatch boundaries were stubbed; no credentials were
  read. A stubbed wrong endpoint is rejected before opening a journal.
- All **3,746 protected history files and three owner files** remain unchanged;
  frozen source37 has no bytecode. All 16 manifest bindings and 33 relative
  document links pass. The new measurement directory is absent.

The manual lead gate binds the reviewed commit/reference through its
authenticated declaration; it does not independently query a GitHub approval
or review verdict. This matches the assigned manual release contract.

## Next action and limits

The lead may now issue the separate authenticated, claimed research-security
data row for this exact accepted plan and commit, with the same profile and
80-attempt limit. This review does not itself grant execution.

The live result, updated denominators, measured accounting and final README
still require their assigned review. Until then, 39/40 remains the honest
measurement claim. Final README must link the new tracked report/adjudication
copy as already recorded by the lead; old sealed pending fields remain intact.

Evidence: `/tmp/fugu-quality-partial-retry-review/source-review-evidence-7a6ed056.json`;
test log: `/tmp/fugu-quality-partial-retry-review/source-tests-7a6ed056.log`;
independent check script: `/tmp/fugu-quality-partial-retry-review/check_candidate.py`.
Reviewer work made **zero provider calls, credential reads, target executions
or Git mutations**. No browser/native-denied checks were repeated.

Any later code/plan/bootstrap change requires another exact-boundary review.
Shared GitHub identity Anton15K cannot formally approve its own PR; the lead
owns publication and must obtain another identity if repository rules require
formal approval. This source verdict is independent agent evidence.
summary: PASS exact 7a6ed056 source/zero-call plan/bootstrap; 67 offline tests and all preservation bindings pass. Separate 80-attempt data grant may follow; measured final review remains.
